messages:
amy_cs: FYI — customer FloraTech opened a case: post-rollout confirmations are rewriting order IDs into words (e.g. ORD-12345 -> \"order twelve three four five\"). They say it started after last night's rollout. Case# FT-4821. Can eng take a look?
floratech_prod: Hi team — attaching the exact snippet we see in prod. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d. Time: 2026-03-12T04:12:30Z. Prompt we send:
```
User: send_order_confirmation(order_id="ORD-12345", items=[...])
System: render_confirmation
```
Response we got: \"Thanks! Your order twelve three four five is confirmed.\" (this used to be \"ORD-12345\").
amy_cs: Gracias. Can you paste the raw request/response logs (prompt logs) and confirm which model/version you were routed to? Also: did you use any client-side escaping or pass order_id as numeric/str?
floratech_prod: Raw request (redacted customer data) below. We pass order_id as a string. No client-side transforms.
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-2026",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"render_confirmation"},
    {"role":"user","content":"send_order_confirmation(order_id=\"ORD-12345\")"}
  ],
  "request_id": "req_0a1b2c3d"
}
```
Response snippet:
```
200 OK
{
  "id": "resp_r0x",
  "output": "Thanks! Your order twelve three four five is confirmed."
}
```
amy_cs: Thanks — forwarding to eng. Sam, Jia: can you triage?
sam_eng: looking. Quick check: deploy bot shows a rollout at 2026-03-12T03:58:12Z that switched routing for small-string inputs to an updated tokenizer profile. tagging @oncall-eng.
eng-deploy-bot: rollout redwood-release/2026.03.12 -> Started at 2026-03-12T03:58:12Z. Changed model routing: redwood-chat-2026 -> redwood-chat-2026-quant (new tokenization profile).
jia_ml: interesting — symptom looks like tokenization / detokenization change for tokens with hyphens. Hyphenated IDs sometimes break if the tokenizer maps characters differently; could be normalization step in the new model variant. Can you paste the full prompt log including any system prompts inserted by the service? Also, do you have the exact bytes of the outgoing request (headers/encoding)?
floratech_prod: here's the full bytes (base64 redacted): we use UTF-8, no normalization on our side. Headers above.
sam_eng: can you run a minimal repro from your environment for us? e.g. curl against the same model endpoint with the exact messages payload and include --verbose so we have request/response headers. That helps rule out client SDK rewriting. Example we use internally to reproduce:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPRO_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-2026","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"render_confirmation"},{"role":"user","content":"send_order_confirmation(order_id=\"ORD-12345\")"}]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
sam_eng: if you can't repro, paste the request_id and exact timestamps — we can pull the internal gateway logs.
floratech_prod: ran the curl from our staging with a repro key, got same result. Request id: repro_req_9f8e7d6c. Verbose headers attached.
jia_ml: got the repro id, thanks. Pulling logs now. Preliminary hypothesis: detokenizer changed to use byte-level spelling for unknown subwords, which would turn ORD-12345 into spelled-out digits when hyphen is treated as separator. Two quick asks: 1) can you confirm whether your downstream renderer treats the output as plain text or applies any HTML/text transforms? 2) can you try pinning model to the previous variant for a short test? Pin example in SDK: 
```
client.generate({ model: "redwood-chat-2026@v1.2.1", messages: [...] })
```
floratech_prod: renderer is plain text. We tried pinning to v1.2.1 and it returns the expected \"ORD-12345\". Pinning works as a workaround.
sam_eng: good — that isolates the issue to the new variant. I'll escalate to runtime and tokenizer teams. Jia, can you dump token spans for the input to see how it's tokenized under both variants?
jia_ml: on it. Running tokenization diff now. Output (trimmed):
```
redwood-chat-2026 (v1.2.1): ["ORD-", "12345"]
redwood-chat-2026-quant (2026.03.12): ["O", "R", "D", "-", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5"]
```
jia_ml: that confirms it — new tokenizer profile is splitting hyphenated alphanumerics to chars, and downstream detokenizer spells out digits. Likely regression introduced in tokenization rules during the rollout.
sam_eng: proposed next steps: 1) rollback tokenizer profile for the variant (fast rollback planned), 2) short-term: route FloraTech to pinned v1.2.1 (they already confirmed it works), 3) longer term: update detokenizer to preserve hyphenated tokens if original input contains alphanumerics with hyphens.
amy_cs: I'll tell the customer the workaround and ETA. FloraTech — can you keep pinned routing for now? We'll notify when rollback completes. ETA for rollback: ~30-45m.
floratech_prod: thanks. We pinned for now. Please let us know when fixed.
oncall-eng: @sam_eng @jia_ml acknowledged — I'll coordinate rollback. Noting potential impact: ~120 customers on the new tokenizer profile, will roll back variant mapping only for hyphen-sensitive routing.
sam_eng: scheduling rollback now, will post updates.
eng-deploy-bot: rollback redwood-release/2026.03.12 -> Started at 2026-03-12T04:20:05Z by oncall-eng.
sam_eng: rollback completed at 2026-03-12T04:26:08Z. Jia, confirm tokenization behavior on the variant after rollback.
jia_ml: post-rollback tokenization diff shows hyphenated tokens preserved. Confirmed.
amy_cs: FloraTech — we rolled back the change and confirmed tokenization is back to previous behavior. Can you validate in staging and confirm?
floratech_prod: validated in staging and production — order IDs now render as ORD-12345. Thanks for fast response :rocket:
amy_cs: closing the case after 24h monitoring window. If anything else pops up please reopen case FT-4821. :white_check_mark:
